title: Halcyon SNOT interceptor
silhouette: A readable nose-to-cockpit spine, distinctive wing arrangement and clearly separate engine masses.

modules.role: Keel plates K1-K4, side-stud course, deck, cockpit floor, pod tops, twin tails
modules.exposes: side studs at x=+-40 and +-120 (Y=-46), forward studs at Z=40, aft studs at Z=240

modules.role: Stepped handed wedge pairs under a 47753 triple-curved wedge
modules.attachment: each wedge pair overlaps the first hull row of the neighbouring keel layer

modules.role: Accent stripe and white flank tiles
modules.attachment: 12 side studs of three 30414 bricks per side
8 side studs of two 30414 bricks per pod

modules.role: Nozzle ring, dish bell, glowing core
Leading-edge strake from handed 4 x 8 wing plates
modules.attachment: inner column sandwiched between K2 and the narrowed K1 core

modules.role: Handed 6 x 12 wing, root splice, tiles, tip fin, cannon mount
modules.attachment: K2 splice runs under the pod; wing at K3 outboard
four cockpit-floor studs at x=+-10, Z=-130/-110
column top studs in the K1 underside

focal_feature: Choose one: split wings, a rotating-looking cockpit, oversized engines, or an asymmetric main blade.
detail_strategy: Use smooth nose armour and broad wing surfaces beside concentrated engine plumbing and service recesses.

scale: Choose minifigure, display or microscale before selecting the canopy and detail sizes.

part_queries.cockpit: a spacecraft canopy with a compatible cockpit rim and pilot controls
part_queries.hull: matched left and right wedge plates and slopes for an angular spaceship hull
part_queries.engines: a cylindrical thruster nacelle with concentric shells, grille intake and exhaust nozzle
part_queries.surface_detail: a small recessed spaceship machinery bay with grilles, bars, clips and dishes
part_queries.supports: a braced frame for long wings, cantilevered engines and a display stand

dimensions_ldu.note: Measured bounds of the ship without its stand: about 29 x 24 x 7 studs.

decisions.coordinates: X width (starboard +X), -Z forward, -Y up; Y=0 keel underside, origin at the keel centre by the wing roots.
decisions.silhouette: Arrowhead from above: pointed nose, strakes that flare into twin pods, swept wings with tip fins. Slim wedge from the side.
decisions.focal_feature: Pointed nose and smoked canopy, balanced by two glowing exhausts.
decisions.pose: Level flight on a round column stand plugged into the keel underside at Z=80.
decisions.surface_rule: No exposed studs on the ship; every SNOT stud face carries a skin or module.
